title: consolidate-premerge-linters-and-ci-shepherd-for-dep-trimming
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: our presubmit plane has accumulated 6 separate linter/test entrypoints that slow fast feedback and confuse contributors. This PR centralizes linting into a single lightweight 'ci-shepherd' composite action, migrates legacy shell-run linters to a typed Node wrapper, and introduces a dependent-presubmit trim step that excludes irrelevant packages from heavyweight integration tests. Changeset summary: (1) new actions/ci-shepherd composite with stage-aware lanes (fast-lint, slow-lint, unit-smoke), (2) migrate eslint/remark invocations into the node-based runner to allow deterministic caching and telemetry, (3) add .ci/dep-trim/indexer that computes minimal test matrix from changed files (opt-in via PR label), (4) update docs/CONTRIBUTING.md and devcontainer instructions, (5) pin a handful of devdeps and update lockfiles to reduce transient failures. Why this matters: median presubmit time for small repos dropped from ~6m to ~90s for fast-lint; heavyweight integrational lanes run only when dep-trim signals touching infra or runtime code. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature flag in workflows, opt-in on a subset of teams, run in shadow for 48h, then roll global. Related: ENG-8821 (presubmit feedback), ENG-8840 (dep-trim spec).
